title: Compilers, Codecs and Language Toolchains: What Agreement Between Builds Can Establish
description:
Two builds can agree even when neither returns the specified result. This research preprint by Aaron Michael Weis presents a source-linked catalogue of 73 compilers, toolchain entries, formats and codecs. In an exhaustive experiment on one Windows host, two C# compilers at two optimization settings agree on all 256 byte inputs, including a deliberately signed variant that returns the wrong value on 128 inputs. A proposed application to the Omega Game Sphere AR engine separates software event replay from possible physical measurements at the Colorado Quantum Incubator. No facility measurements or partnership are claimed.

Read the versioned PDF. The deposited archive includes the identical PDF, paper text, catalogue, example code, raw observations and component licenses.
